wt/kdt132-watermarks, pushed; based on 6ef642f36). analyze_activation
reporting one derivation per answer -- CallSite(k) owns

prefixes of the dataflow-ordered reads vector; WholeBody owns
ReturnType/ActivationAnalyzed. All adversarial-review fixes folded (blocked
runs' answers no longer read concluded; changed-only facts reach a
derivation; routed claims without standing answers fall back to the job's
read set). Gates green; backend byte-neutral; all pins held.

PARKED because measured cost exceeds current benefit: +6-10% wall clock
(per-derivation ledger traffic + standing_derivations cloning) for one-hop
cleanliness NO consumer reads -- the precision is erased by job-wide wait
dirtying and the caller<->callee 2-cycle (only the drain arbiter discharges
those facts). Finality-first pop was PROVEN invariant under this change (the
whole-body answer reads everything; ready-alternative rate identical at base
and commit: 0.4%/0.0%/1.3%) -- do not rebuild it.

DISPOSITION (74 refuted; standalone conditions govern): landing this
requires: something that
consumes the precision (was: fz-kdt.68-class work), plus the per-derivation
re-list fix (the gate's standing-claims re-list is job-scoped and would
collapse sibling derivations into SOLE -- must become per-derivation via
standing_derivations), plus the recompute-with-fixed-reads soundness
property test.
